description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Giants released DL Sam Roberts.
items.impact: Roberts will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.
items.title: Sam Roberts released by Giants

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Giants signed DB JT Woods.
items.impact: Woods spent last season on the Jets practice squad. He will compete for a depth role in the Giants secondary.
items.title: JT Woods signs with Giants

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers released Nick Zakelj.
items.impact: Zakelj will figure to seek another opportunity.
items.title: Nick Zakelj released by 49ers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers signed OL Doug Kramer Jr.
items.impact: Kramer will add depth in training camp with the 49ers offensive line banged up.
items.title: Doug Kramer Jr. signs with 49ers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Chargers waived WR Mante Morrow.
items.impact: Morrow will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.
items.title: Mante Morrow waived by Chargers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Chargers signed LB Andre Carter II.
items.impact: Carter will compete for a depth role in the Chargers linebacker room.
items.title: Andre Carter II signs with Chargers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Falcons signed DL Cameron Sample.
items.impact: Sample was released last week by the 49ers. He will compete for a depth role on the Falcons defensive line.
items.title: Cameron Sample signs with Falcons

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Divine Deablo missed practice on Monday.
items.impact: Deablo is not believed to be dealing with a serious injury.
items.title: Divine Deablo absent from practice Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans placed LB Sione Takitaki on injured reserve.
items.impact: Takitaki is likely to miss the upcoming season due to a hamstring injury.
items.title: Sione Takitaki (hamstring) placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: L'Jarius Sneed did not practice on Monday.
items.impact: Sneed is managing a knee injury. It is unclear how serious the injury is for the veteran.
items.title: L'Jarius Sneed (knee) does not practice Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Trey Smith remained absent from practice on Monday.
items.impact: Smith began dealing with a hip injury last week. It is not believed to be serious.
items.title: Trey Smith (hip) misses practice Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Drue Tranquill did not practice on Monday.
items.impact: Tranquill was dealing with a back strain last week. He remains day-to-day.
items.title: Drue Tranquill (back) misses practice Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Broncos activated LB Jordan Turner from the non-football injury list.
items.impact: Turner was sidelined to begin training camp. He has been cleared to return to practice.
items.title: Jordan Turner activated from NFI list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Buccaneers signed CB Roman Parodie.
items.impact: Parodie spent the spring in the UFL. He was with the Bucs last year as an undrafted rookie.
items.title: Roman Parodie signs with Bucs

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Buccaneers waived-injured veteran Kemon Hall.
items.impact: Hall will figure to seek another opportunity once he is cleared.
items.title: Kemon Hall waived by Bucs

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Packers claimed WR Chris Hilton Jr. off waivers.
items.impact: Hilton will compete for a depth role in the Packers wide receiver room.
items.title: Chris Hilton Jr. claimed off waivers by Packers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Giants coach John Harbaugh said Dru Phillips has a minor knee injury.
items.impact: It doesn't appear to be too serious. Phillips could miss some practice time early in the week.
items.title: Dru Phillips dealing with minor knee injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Giants coach John Harbaugh said Greg Newsome II has a minor knee injury.
items.impact: It doesn't appear to be too serious. Newsome could miss some practice time early in the week.
items.title: Greg Newsome II dealing with minor knee injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Giants coach John Harbaugh said Abdul Carter has hand injury.
items.impact: It does not appear to be anything serious for Carter.
items.title: Abdul Carter has hand injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Patriots have traded Caedan Wallace to the Miami Dolphins.
items.impact: It was previously reported that Wallace was released by New England. He instead gets a fresh start in Miami via a trade.
items.title: Caedan Wallace traded to Dolphins

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Marquez Valdes-Scantling did not practice on Sunday due to shoulder soreness.
items.impact: Archer notes that Valdes-Scantling had a hard fall during practice. He is competing for a depth role in the Cowboys wide receiver room.
items.title: Marquez Valdes-Scantling battling shoulder injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jake Bobo returned to practice on Monday.
items.impact: Bobo was absent from practice the past two weeks due to a hamstring injury. He'll remain in a depth role in the Seahawks wide receiver room.
items.title: Jake Bobo (hamstring) returns to practice

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bears waived WR Kyron Hudson with an Injury designation.
items.impact: Hudson will figure to seek another opportunity when he is cleared.
items.title: Kyron Hudson waived by Bears

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bears signed WR Ray-Ray McCloud III.
items.impact: McCloud appeared in two games with the Giants last season. He will compete for a depth role at wide receiver and on special teams.
items.title: Ray-Ray McCloud III signs with Bears

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Lions placed DT Aidan Keanaaina on injured reserve.
items.impact: Keanaaina is likely to miss the upcoming season.
items.title: Aidan Keanaaina placed on IR

title: Fantasy Player News
